metadata.title: Building Payment Apps with Bolt.new and MoneyGraph
metadata.description: How to use Bolt.new (StackBlitz) with MoneyGraph SDK. Build and deploy payment applications directly in your browser.
metadata.author: MoneyGraph Team

seo.og_description: Build payment applications in your browser with Bolt.new. Our integration guide includes server actions, React components, and deployment tips.

content.intro: Bolt.new (powered by StackBlitz) is a browser-based AI development environment. Build and deploy full-stack applications without leaving your browser. With MoneyGraph SDK, you can create fintech applications in minutes.

steps: Create Vite + React + TypeScript project in Bolt.new
